gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-wix-madefor-disp: Chunky and hand-cut, Balsamiq Sans has round letters whose walls weigh as much as its straight ones. And Wix Madefor Display takes the opposite job, curve ends flaring gently and staying apart, with a low, contemporary hush.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau: Loud, rounded and rope-like, Balsamiq Sans bends its curves with the same heft as its straights, never pinching anywhere. Ysabeau sweeps in beside it, curves left wide open.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau-office: Fat, tube-like strokes of constant width give Balsamiq Sans a bold, bouncy look that never tightens at a curve. Ysabeau Office keeps its curves open-ended beside it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC wears a visibly gaping c at any size, giving it a modern, professional manner with a low lowercase. But Balsamiq Sans, a monoline display face from start to finish, adds the loud bit.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Expressive and bold, Balsamiq Sans draws one monoline stroke with no pinched turns, while ZCOOL XiaoWei lets its stems swell and thin moderately. One is a marker line, the other a sharper sans-serif.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-: Approachable and sturdy, Zen Kaku Gothic New has open-mouthed curves. Balsamiq Sans does its best work as a bold, expressive display voice with no tight turns, while Zen Kaku Gothic New is happiest in body text with no hairlines and no swells.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-pilcrow-rounded: A crescent-wrench c, opened wide and drawn at one thickness, is the calling card of Baumans. Pilcrow Rounded works at the other end, with big counters and a tall lowercase that never closes its curves, while Baumans earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Alegreya Sans SC brings a modern, welcoming gap in its c and a low lowercase. And Baumans, with an s whose spine matches its terminals in thickness, gives the pair its commanding streak.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-cairo: Baumans opens with a crescent-wrench c and one thickness throughout. Cairo then carries the reading, a modern sans-serif whose wide channel into every bowl keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-commissioner: Commanding in its crescent-wrench c, Baumans draws every stroke at one thickness, and Commissioner does the same in its body text. A long passage reads smoothly, with no clogged curves.
